name: St Sebastian and St Boniface, Pendleton

boundary.description: From the junction of Bury New Road and Broughton Lane, S along Bury New Road and Sherborne Steet West to the end of the road and by a beeline to and W along River Irwell to the point opposite the junction of University Road and Wallness Lane. Then W by the University Road to the railway, and by Salford Crescent – Swinton railway to the point opposite the junction of Barfield Road and Bolton Road and by a beeline N to the Salford Crescent – Clifton railway. By that railway to and E along Agecroft Road to and S along River Irwell to the point opposite Regatta Street. By a beeline NE to and along South Radford Street, Kingsley Avenue and by a beeline to the River Irwell. E along the River Irwell to the point opposite The Priory, then E by the Priory, Great Clowes Street and Broughton Lane to its junction with Bury New Road.
